errors.text: The target FeNiCrMn single-crystal bulk MD system is replaced by an unspecified CoCrFeNi-like, possibly polycrystalline experimental alloy.
The proposed strain-rate range of 10^-4 to 10^-1 s^-1 does not reconstruct the simulated 10^8 to 10^10 s^-1 regime.

Strain-rate-insensitive yielding is incorrectly assigned to elevated-temperature dislocation climb or transformation kinetics rather than being bounded to the target MD rate range and partial-dislocation nucleation mechanism.

Twinning and bulk FCC-to-HCP transformation are proposed as likely mediators, whereas the target exhibits Shockley partials and stacking-fault-induced local HCP signatures without twinning or bulk phase transformation.
Crystallographic loading directions and the maximum yield strength along <-111> are omitted.
